selection: Maximum lower endpoint of the grouped validation interval for the nonlinear raw conditional bound, earliest round on ties; never differences of MI lower bounds.
hypotheses: The frozen nonlinear four-state operator retains shell information beyond all eight ordered ternary corners at beta=3.05 in a uniform cubic frame.
gate: Only the beta-9 test estimate is primary. Require its lower endpoint >0, no positive beta-0 bound, nonpositive averaged permutation null, positive archived-shell planted signal and fair-bit calibration agreement. beta-8 transfer, affine scores and fixed axes are secondary. Nonpositive bounds do not imply absence.
interval: Two-sided Bonferroni 98.333333% Student intervals over means of disjoint, equal-sized parent blocks; approximate iid-block inference, not independent sites, panels, seeds or exact finite-sample coverage.
